about: The two TF2 launchers you can hold in TF2 mode. Distances in Hammer units (HU), times in seconds. Unlimited mode: no clip, no reserve, no reload; fire rates stay TF2's.

columns.id: row id, also the generated C# name
columns.displayName: name shown in the HUD hint
columns.tf2Class: classes row whose arms hold it
columns.weaponModel: assets row: the c_model weapon, bone-merged onto the arms
columns.weaponSkin: skin family of the weapon model (0 = stock RED)
columns.drawSeq: arms sequence played when switching to it
columns.fireSeq: arms sequence played on each shot
columns.spawnForwardHU: projectile spawn offset from the eye, forward
columns.spawnRightHU: projectile spawn offset from the eye, right
columns.spawnUpHU: projectile spawn offset from the eye, up
columns.aimTraceHU: how far the crosshair trace reaches when aiming the projectile at what you look at
columns.launchSpeedMaxHU: launch speed at full charge (HU/s); same as min when the weapon has no charge
columns.chargeTime: seconds to full charge (0 = no charge, fires on press)
columns.launchJitterHU: random launch speed added along view right/up (HU/s)
columns.maxActive: most projectiles alive at once; firing past it detonates the oldest (0 = no limit)
columns.fireSound: assets row played on each shot
columns.chargeSound: assets row played while charging, or none
columns.altFire: what right click does: detonate or none
columns.altFireSound: assets row played on right click, or none

rows.source: TF2 SDK tf_weaponbase_rocket.cpp (1100 HU/s), tf_weaponbase_gun.cpp FireRocket offset (23.5, 12, -3); weapon script TimeFireDelay 0.8

TF2 SDK tf_weapon_pipebomblauncher.h (TF_PIPEBOMB_MIN/MAX_CHARGE_VEL 900/2400, MAX_CHARGE_TIME 4.0, TF_WEAPON_PIPEBOMB_COUNT 8), FirePipeBomb (+200 up, +-10 jitter, offset 16/8/-6); weapon script TimeFireDelay 0.6
